module: TrafficStops, mandatory only in this ruleset; old saves unchanged and not upgraded

rules.road: At entry observe closure; plan from own knowledge. Detour if possible, otherwise stop AtSite. Do not undo current crossing.
rules.sea: Check locally while waiting through exact departure instant. Outage stops trip at port. Already afloat actor/courier completes crossing.
rules.same_time: Conditions then personal redirect then local route/departure check; a committed redirect is not rolled back if new route becomes unavailable.
rules.reopening: No automatic launch. Actor must inspect updated local state and explicitly submit a new trip, including fresh boarding preparation.
rules.couriers: Waiting sea courier fails physically at port; failure return uses original dispatch node, not recipient live location. Already afloat courier continues.
rules.privacy: Truth conditions never enter personal planning; closures learned only at local edge/port, remote lord by physical report.

fixtures: road: all incident roads close at redirect effective time
detour: selected next road closes at redirect effective time
port: sea service closes exactly at departure
fixture_status: Synthetic reproducible schedules, not historical incidents or actual ferry services

video.capture: Actual Godot Movie Maker frames; scripted game actions, no native input
video.scope: Road closure and service suspension conflicts; local knowledge, explicit restart,12 independent save stages

limitations: No automatic resumption; explicit restart policy adopted for this trial
No weather simulation, capacity, queues, fares or port access rights
Mid-edge road closure/current crossing continues; hazards destroying a road under a traveler not modeled
Geography remains approximate; no historical service schedule or port reconstruction
